data.sub: 10+ shehron mein raat ka taapmaan 10 degree se kam

chat.say: Mummy kambal aur geyser dono on kar do!
Pehle time pe nahana shuru kar nalayak!

data.asar: Ab roz nahane ke naye bahane dhoondhne padenge
data.caption:
Thand ki solid entry ho chuki hai boss! 🥶

• Season mein pehli baar Mount Abu mein para jamaav bindu tak gira.
• 10 se zyada shehron mein raat ka taapmaan 10 degree se neeche pahuncha.
• Rajasthan mein din mein dhoop aur raat mein kadake ki thand shuru.

Ab se roz geyser on aur nahane ke bahane dhundhna officially chalu!

Tag karo apne us dost ko jo ab seedha Holi par hi nahayega!
